timelinePanel.title: Timeline
timelinePanel.noProject: Create a project to start editing the timeline.
timelinePanel.mutedBySolo: Muted because another track is soloed
timelinePanel.markerTooltip: Marker — click to seek, double-click to remove
timelinePanel.lanesRegion: Timeline tracks — drag to select clips
timelinePanel.syncGroupNeedsTwo: Select 2 or more clips to create a sync group

mediaLibrary.emptyTitle: No media yet. Drag & drop files here, or use Import Files / Import Folder.

videoPlayer.selectMediaPrompt: Select media from the Media Library to preview it.

silenceDetector.title: Silence Detector
silenceDetector.explainer: Silence detection never modifies your source media — it only analyzes it and proposes edits to clips already on this timeline. Nothing is written back to the original file.
silenceDetector.noTracks: No audio/video tracks in this project yet
silenceDetector.noClips: No clips with media on this track
silenceDetector.channelUnsupportedTooltip: Per-channel selection isn't supported by the backend yet — PCM extraction always downmixes to mono.
silenceDetector.channelUnsupportedHint: Not yet supported by the backend (mono only)
silenceDetector.regionsEmpty: Run Analyze to detect speech/silence regions.
silenceDetector.summaryLine: {{segments}} speech segments detected · {{removed}} of {{total}} proposed for removal

syncGroup.explainer: Groups the selected clips (master prompt §39) so a silence cut applied to one linked track — e.g. a microphone — trims every other linked track together. Best-effort alignment only, not frame-accurate.
syncGroup.timecodeUnavailableHint: Timecode alignment isn't available for these clips (missing creation timestamps) — enter offsets manually below.
syncGroup.manualHint: Enter each clip's offset in milliseconds relative to the group.

exportDialog.title: Export
exportDialog.crfHint: Lower = higher quality, larger file (18–28 typical)

transcriptEditor.modeTextExplainer: Correcting text here only fixes the transcript itself — it never changes your timeline or video.
transcriptEditor.modeVideoExplainer: Deleting text here proposes a real cut to your video. Nothing is removed until you review and confirm it below.
transcriptEditor.seekMissed: That moment isn't covered by any clip currently on the timeline.
transcriptEditor.noClipSelected: Select a clip on the timeline to see its transcript.
transcriptEditor.noTranscript: This clip's media has no transcript yet.
transcriptEditor.confirmExplainer: This will remove the following ranges from the clip on your timeline. This cannot be undone except via Undo.
transcriptEditor.stageEntryTooltip: Stage this whole sentence for deletion
transcriptEditor.selectSentenceTooltip: Select this sentence's range on the timeline
transcriptEditor.noWordDataTooltip: No word-level timing for this entry — click to seek to its start

fillerWordDetector.title: Filler Word Detector
fillerWordDetector.explainer: Detects filler words ("um", "kiểu như", …) using this clip's transcript timestamps and proposes candidate cuts. Nothing is removed until you review and Apply.
fillerWordDetector.noTranscriptHint: This clip's media has no transcript yet — transcribe it from the Transcript tab first.
fillerWordDetector.candidatesEmpty: Run Detect to find filler-word candidates.

modelManager.title: Model Manager
modelManager.explainer: Local transcription runs entirely on this machine once a model is installed — no audio is ever sent anywhere. Larger models are more accurate but slower and take more disk space. Downloads are resumable and only counted as installed once fully verified.

captionsPanel.noProject: Create a project to work with captions.
captionsPanel.noTranscriptHint: This project has no transcript yet — transcribe some media from the Transcript tab first.
captionsPanel.captionsEmpty: No captions yet — generate some above, or they'll appear here once you do.
captionsPanel.splitAtPlayhead: Split this caption at the current playhead position
captionsPanel.styleDirtyHint: Unsaved changes — save before applying to captions.

capcutSettings.title: CapCut / Jianying Settings
capcutSettings.explainer: Detects CapCut/Jianying Pro drafts installed on this Windows machine so Export to CapCut knows where to write. Detection is read-only — this panel never creates, modifies, or overwrites anything by itself.
capcutSettings.noneDetected: No CapCut or Jianying Pro installation was detected automatically. This is expected if neither is installed, or if this build is running on a non-Windows host — use the manual override below instead.
capcutSettings.registryExplainer: Read from the Windows uninstall registry as a secondary signal only — no confirmed registry key is known for either product, so treat the version/install-location values below as hints, not certainties. This never gates or replaces the filesystem detection above.
capcutSettings.noneInRegistry: No CapCut/Jianying entries found in the registry.
capcutSettings.overrideExplainer: Point Export to CapCut at a different draft directory — useful when nothing was auto-detected, or you keep drafts somewhere else.
capcutSettings.effectivePathNone: No draft directory known yet — detect one above or set a manual override.

capcutExport.title: Export to CapCut
capcutExport.noProject: Create or load a project first.
capcutExport.noExistingDraftChosen: No existing draft folder chosen yet.
capcutExport.noDraftRootKnown: No CapCut/Jianying draft directory is known yet — open CapCut Settings to detect one or set a manual override.
capcutExport.warnEffects: {{count}} effect(s) in this project — CapCut/Jianying effect, filter, and transition resource IDs aren't resolved against a real catalog yet, so these will carry over as unresolved references CapCut may not render as intended.
capcutExport.warnAnimations: {{count}} animation(s) in this project — CapCut animation resource IDs aren't resolved against a real catalog yet, so these may not play back as intended in CapCut.
capcutExport.warnKeyframes: {{count}} keyframe(s) use a property this adapter doesn't map to CapCut yet (only position, rotation, uniform scale, opacity, and volume keyframes are supported) — those will be skipped, not fabricated.
capcutExport.noWarnings: No known compatibility issues detected for this project's current content.
capcutExport.limitationsNote: General known limitation: CapCut/Jianying's built-in effect/filter/transition/font catalogs haven't been ported (this app has no such catalog of its own yet), so any of those references pass through unresolved rather than mapped to a real CapCut resource.
capcutExport.confirmBody: This writes a CapCut draft to:
capcutExport.confirmOverwriteWarning: If a draft already exists at this path, its contents will be overwritten. This cannot be undone from within this app.

aiSettings.title: AI Settings
aiSettings.explainer: Configure which AI provider natural-language editing and Smart Edit call. Non-secret settings (provider, base URL, model, temperature, timeout) are saved on this machine only; the API key is written directly to Windows Credential Manager and is never sent back to this app once saved.
aiSettings.keyRecommended: Recommended for this provider (most cloud endpoints reject requests without one).
aiSettings.keyOptional: Optional — usually not needed for a local endpoint.
aiSettings.keyNeverRedisplayedNote: For security, a saved key is never displayed again — only whether one is configured.

aiCommandBox.title: AI Command
aiCommandBox.explainer: Type a plain-language editing instruction, e.g. "Remove all silence longer than 800ms.", "Remove filler words.", or "Remove the intro." The AI proposes an edit plan below — nothing on the timeline changes until you review it and click Apply.
aiCommandBox.noTranscriptHint: This media has no transcript yet — filler-word/wording-based commands work best with one (Transcript Editor), but pure timing commands like "remove all silence longer than 800ms" can still work without it.
aiCommandBox.commandPlaceholder: e.g. Remove all silence longer than 800ms.
aiCommandBox.opZoomNotAppliedBadge: Not applied yet — Zoom operations aren't wired to the timeline in this build
aiCommandBox.noOperationsApplicable: This plan has no Remove operations to apply.

smartEdit.title: Smart Edit
smartEdit.explainer: AI reviews this clip's transcript and proposes edits — repetition, false starts, off-topic sections, weak sentences, long pauses, filler words, unnecessary intros, duplicate ideas, and boring sections. Every recommendation is a proposal: review it, override its action if you disagree, then Apply only what you approve.
smartEdit.noTranscriptHint: Selected media has no transcript yet — transcribe it first (Transcript Editor).
smartEdit.aiNotConfiguredHint: No AI provider is configured yet — open AI Settings to configure one before analyzing.
smartEdit.seekMissed: That moment isn't covered by any clip currently on the timeline.
smartEdit.previewEmpty: Nothing will be cut with the current actions.

highlightDetection.title: Highlight Detection
highlightDetection.explainer: Detects candidate highlight moments from transcript, speech density, audio energy, and scene changes — plus semantic importance when an AI provider is configured. Each result shows a score, a suggested title, and why it was picked.
highlightDetection.aiNotConfiguredHint: No AI provider is configured yet — detection will use local signals only (speech density, audio energy, scene changes).
highlightDetection.noTranscriptNote: Selected media has no transcript yet — detection can still run using audio/scene signals only.
highlightDetection.resultsEmpty: No highlights yet — click Detect Highlights.
highlightDetection.seekMissed: That moment isn't covered by any clip currently on the timeline.
highlightDetection.createProjectConfirmButton: Click again to confirm — discards current project
highlightDetection.createProjectNote: There is no Project Manager yet — this replaces whatever is currently open in memory. Export/save first if you need to keep it.

shortsGenerator.title: Short Video Generator
shortsGenerator.explainer: Turns a long video into several short, vertical (or square) clips ready for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or Instagram Reels: it finds the best moments, extracts and reframes each one to your chosen aspect, adds captions, and optionally applies auto-zoom. Each generated short is a real, fully editable project — nothing renders to a video file until you export it yourself.
shortsGenerator.noTranscriptNote: Selected media has no transcript yet. Open the Transcript tab and transcribe this media first — the Short Video Generator needs a transcript to detect highlights and generate captions.
shortsGenerator.resultsEmpty: No candidates were generated — try a different duration/clip count, or check that the selected media is long enough.
shortsGenerator.loadConfirmButton: Click again to confirm — discards current project
shortsGenerator.loadConfirmNote: There is no Project Manager yet — this replaces whatever is currently open in memory. Export/save first if you need to keep it.

batchJobs.title: Batch Jobs
batchJobs.noBatchesYet: No batches started yet this session — click "Start New Batch…" to process several files through one pipeline.

startBatchDialog.title: Start New Batch
startBatchDialog.noModelsInstalled: No transcription model is installed yet — open Models… from the top bar first.
startBatchDialog.multiTemplateHint: Pick one or more templates below. Every selected video is rendered once per selected template (e.g. 2 videos × 3 templates = 6 distinctly-named output files).
startBatchDialog.previewHint: Runs the real probing/template/silence-removal analysis for the first selected file only, using the settings above — no render happens.

dryRunPanel.noTemplate: No template resolved — the export preset is used directly
dryRunPanel.aiNone: No AI recommendation shown (a template is already chosen, or no AI provider is configured)
dryRunPanel.aiProposalNote: A proposal only — pick "{{name}}" above yourself to actually use it.

history.title: History
history.empty: No finished jobs yet — history rows appear here once a batch job completes.

sceneDetector.title: Scene Detector
sceneDetector.explainer: Detects real scene cuts in the selected clip's media (real ffmpeg-based analysis, not a guess) and shows each one with its own thumbnail and score. Select which scenes to split at or remove, or generate highlight candidates directly from them.
sceneDetector.applyModeHint: Only applies to "Remove Selected" — "Split at Selected" always splits the chosen clip itself.
sceneDetector.thresholdHint: Lower values detect more (softer) cuts; higher values only detect strong scene changes.
sceneDetector.resultsEmpty: No scenes detected yet — pick a clip and press Detect.

autoZoom.noClipSelected: Select a clip on the timeline to configure auto-zoom for it.
autoZoom.markersHint: Check which timeline markers should trigger a zoom-in (the master prompt's "manual markers" trigger).
autoZoom.noMarkers: No markers on the timeline yet.
autoZoom.scenesHint: Detects real scene cuts for this clip's media so long, static scenes can trigger a zoom-in.
autoZoom.emphasisNotWiredHint: "Important sentence" / "speaker emphasis" triggers aren't wired in this pass — no command yet exposes the underlying audio-energy analysis to the frontend.

broll.title: B-Roll Suggestions
broll.explainer: AI suggests B-roll moments from this clip's transcript (keyword, reason, and time range), each paired with real local media that actually matches — no automatic downloads, ever.
broll.aiNotConfiguredHint: Configure an AI provider in AI Settings… to get B-roll suggestions
broll.resultsEmpty: No suggestions yet — transcribe this clip's media, then press Suggest B-Roll.
broll.noLocalCandidates: No local B-roll found for this suggestion — import matching footage into the Media Library, then try again.

assetLibrary.title: Asset Library
assetLibrary.explainer: A small catalog of your own reusable files — intro/outro clips, logo/watermark images, background music, and more — each registered once and referenced by templates via a stable id instead of a hardcoded path. Files are referenced in place, never copied.
assetLibrary.structuralKindNote: This kind isn't referenced by any template field yet — registering it is bookkeeping only, for now.
assetLibrary.consumedSectionNote: Intro, Outro, Logo, Watermark, and Music assets can be referenced from a template's intro/outro/watermark/background-music fields.
assetLibrary.structuralSectionTitle: Registered, not used by any feature yet
assetLibrary.structuralSectionNote: These kinds are part of the catalog, but no template field or render feature consumes them yet.

automationRules.title: Automation Rules
automationRules.explainer: Rules that watch a folder for new videos and automatically run them through a batch pipeline (Smart Automation, upgrade spec §27) — "when a new video appears in folder X, if it's at least N minutes long, apply template Y and export."
automationRules.noRules: No automation rules yet — add one to start watching a folder.

list.conditionNone: No condition — every new video runs

form.title: New Automation Rule
form.conditionCheckboxLabel: Only process videos at least this long
form.multiTemplateToggle: Apply multiple templates (fan out one job per template)
form.multiTemplateHint: Every new video will be run once per checked template below.
form.noTemplatesYet: No templates available yet — create one in the Templates panel first.
form.scopeHint: Silence removal and captions aren't configurable per rule yet — this v1 focuses on the template + export step. Use Batch's own Start Batch dialog for full control once the file has arrived.

templatesPanel.appliedNote: Applied "{{name}}" to the current project (canvas + caption style).
templatesPanel.silenceSettingsFromDetector: Captured from Silence Detector's current padding/merge settings
templatesPanel.includeSportsOverlayLabel: Include sports overlay defaults (score overlay + music ducking)
templatesPanel.assetsSectionNote: Pick a registered asset for each slot, or leave it as "None" to leave that field unset.
templatesPanel.noAssetsNote: No assets registered yet — use the "Assets…" button in the top bar to add one.
templatesPanel.historyEmpty: No earlier versions — this template has never been updated.

updateSettings.title: Software Updates
updateSettings.explainer: Choose how AI Video Editor checks for new versions. An update is never installed while a render or batch job is running — it's deferred until your current job finishes.
updateSettings.statusDeferred: Version {{version}} is ready, but will be installed after your current render or batch job finishes.
updateSettings.statusInstalling: Installing update — the app will restart shortly.

systemInfo.title: System Information
systemInfo.explainer: A snapshot of this machine and this app's real detected state — handy to include with a bug report.
systemInfo.capcutVersionNotTracked: not tracked (this app detects CapCut/Jianying by its draft folder, not by reading a version number)
systemInfo.projectDirectoryNotApplicable: not applicable yet (this app has no Project Manager / default project directory feature yet)

firstRunWizard.title: AI Video Editor Setup
firstRunWizard.closeTooltip: Close (reopens next launch if not finished)
firstRunWizard.welcomeBody: This short setup wizard checks your system, helps you configure optional AI features, and gets you ready to start editing. Every step except this one and the last can be skipped — the basic editor works fully without any of them.
firstRunWizard.systemCheckBody: A quick look at this machine before going step by step through the details.
firstRunWizard.checkFfmpegMissing: FFmpeg not found — the next step has more detail
firstRunWizard.checkEncoderSoftwareOnly: No working hardware encoder — software (CPU) encoding will be used, which is slower but fully functional
firstRunWizard.checkCapcutNotFound: CapCut/Jianying not detected (optional — only needed for CapCut export)
firstRunWizard.ffmpegBody: AI Video Editor uses FFmpeg for every render/export and FFprobe to read media metadata.
firstRunWizard.ffmpegNotFoundHint: FFmpeg was not found on this machine. A packaged installer bundles it automatically; if you built this app from source, run scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.ps1 once.
firstRunWizard.gpuBody: Hardware video encoders this machine's FFmpeg build can actually use — detected with a real smoke-test encode, not just listed.
firstRunWizard.gpuNoneDetected: No hardware encoders detected — software (CPU) encoding will be used.
firstRunWizard.capcutBody: CapCut/Jianying integration is optional — only needed if you plan to export drafts for further editing there.
firstRunWizard.capcutNoneDetected: No CapCut or Jianying installation detected on this machine.
firstRunWizard.aiProviderBody: Cloud or local AI powers natural-language editing, Smart Edit suggestions, and highlight detection. The basic editor — import, cut, timeline, render, captions, CapCut export — works fully without any of this.
firstRunWizard.transcriptionModelBody: Download a local whisper.cpp model to enable transcripts, captions, and silence/filler-word detection. You can always download one later from the Models… button.
firstRunWizard.projectFolderBody: Choose a default folder the save dialogs will suggest when exporting or saving files. This is only a convenience default — not a required or enforced project location, and nothing is moved or created here automatically.
firstRunWizard.readyBody: AI Video Editor is ready to use. You can revisit any of these settings anytime from the toolbar.
firstRunWizard.readyReopenHint: You can run this setup wizard again anytime from the "Setup Wizard…" button in the toolbar.

autoTemplate.title: AI Auto Template
autoTemplate.explainer: AI analyzes this video's real duration, aspect ratio, speech, scenes, and important moments, then recommends one template from your catalog (built-in or custom) — a proposal only, never applied automatically.
autoTemplate.noTranscriptNote: Selected media has no transcript yet — the recommendation will rely on duration, aspect, and scene signals only.
autoTemplate.aiNotConfiguredHint: No AI provider is configured yet — Suggest Template will fail until one is set up in AI Settings.
autoTemplate.resultEmpty: No recommendation yet — click Suggest Template.
autoTemplate.recommendationUnresolved: This recommended template is no longer in your catalog.
autoTemplate.appliedNote: Applied "{{name}}" to the current project (canvas + caption style, plus pre-filled zoom/silence/export settings).

templateGenerator.title: AI Template Generator
templateGenerator.explainer: Describe the template you want in plain language. AI converts it into a structured template definition, validated against your real caption styles, export presets, and Asset Library — then you preview it and, if it looks right, save it as a reusable custom template.
templateGenerator.promptPlaceholder: e.g. "Create a TikTok-style football highlight template. 30-45 seconds, 9:16, large subtitles, highlight player names, logo in the top-right corner, 2-second intro, fast transitions."
templateGenerator.previewEmpty: No template generated yet — describe what you want above and click Generate.
templateGenerator.savedNote: Saved "{{name}}" — it now appears in your template gallery, ready to reuse.
